# Beyond Pixells
> Beyond Pixells is a modern product studio, founded by Somil Sharma in India, that builds
> sector-specific operating systems for local businesses. Tagline: "We build operating
> systems for local businesses."

## Core Capabilities
- Vertical SaaS products ("__ OS" family): Gym OS, Dentist OS, Builder OS
- Custom client rollouts: branded website + member portal + owner dashboard + WhatsApp automation
- Services: websites and landing pages, marketing automation, digital products
- India-native engineering: WhatsApp-first, UPI payments, GST, flat INR pricing

## Key Products
- Gym OS (live): https://somilsharma2000.github.io/gym-os/ — gym management: WhatsApp automation, QR check-in, lead CRM, UPI collection. Pricing: setup fee + flat monthly (₹999–₹1,999), unlimited members.
- Dentist OS (live demo): https://somilsharma2000.github.io/dentist-os/ — dental clinic management.
- Builder OS (in development): https://somilsharma2000.github.io/builder-os-site/ — real-estate builder operations.

## Facts
- 8 branded client systems live in production
- 32-module product spec, 45+ data entities in production platform
- Pricing model: one-time setup + flat monthly subscription, no per-member fees
